answers.evidence: t001-t002 give the stake with a number: "你在台灣一定認得兩個山葉" / "二〇二五年台灣新掛牌的機車，有十二萬五千多台是山葉。" By t003-t006 (00:13-00:25) the viewer is in a concrete moment: "一九五五年七月十日，富士山的登山賽。" "起跑線上，有一款新來的小機車。" (Borderline: t002 tells you why it matters to you, more than what the story changed, but it does carry a number.)

The opening holds back the race result (t005 "起跑線上，有一款新來的小機車", which is resolved only at t094). It also holds back what the war left (t008 "留下了一樣它沒想到的東西", resolved at t058) and how the positions changed (t009 "跟當年已經很不一樣了", resolved at t136-t138). The answer to t011 comes only at t144.

After the 1955 cold open, the story runs in order: 1887 (t012) -> 1897 (t028) -> 1921/1939 (t033, t041) -> 1944-45 (t048-t051) -> 1953 (t063) -> Feb/Jul 1955 (t076, t088, t092) -> 1965-1996 (t110-t122) -> 2007-2026 (t124-t136). Returns to earlier moments are one-line callbacks (t058, t077, t092), not retellings.
The only framing line is the single promise at t010: "這份檔案，一百三十多年的帳，一頁一頁翻給你看。" It names a scale. No line announces sections or lists what comes later.

t012 "那台機車之前六十八年…" picks up the opening's bike. t032 "那個客人，是日本陸軍。" answers t031. t050 "五月那場空襲…" picks up t048-t049. t063 has the president (t061 "社長很頭痛") give the order that answers t062. t087 "他們不但沒停" answers t086. t102 "它帶走了。" answers t101. t124's shareholding opens the ledger that t123 "帳本上，寫的是另一回事" promised.

Callbacks from far back name what they answer: t006/t007 strangeness -> t077 "開頭那件怪事就在這裡：型錄右下角印的公司名，是日本樂器". t008 -> t058 "還記得開頭說的那樣東西嗎？就是這批做螺旋槳的機器". t021 -> t079-t080 (藝大's associate professor did the colours). t009 -> t138 "還記得開頭說，兩個山葉的位置不一樣了嗎？就是這個". t011 -> t143-t144 "不是同一家…營收是鋼琴那家的五倍多". Nearby questions are all answered at once: t016->t019, t034->t035-t038, t062->t064, t093->t094, t104->t105-t106, t113->t114, t135->t136, t142->t144.

Every number is said once: 十二萬五千 (t002), 四千零三十三/兩千五百六十七 (t041-t042), 八百台 (t054), 兩百零四/四十二/三千兩百 (t070-t071), 十三萬八千 (t084), 二十九分零七秒 (t094), 百分之二十二點七 (t124), 百分之一點四六 (t136) and 百分之三點二 (t137). Repeated facts come back as named callbacks only: t058, t077, t079, t092 "開頭那場富士山登山賽", t138 and t143. (Minor: t039 restates t038's piano/propeller woodworking point as a reflection.)
Every title names an event or reveal: "一八八七年，一台被打槍的風琴", "一九二一年，陸軍來訂螺旋槳", "一九四五年，燒掉的是做樂器的機器", "一九五三年，一道極機密的命令", "成立九天，就去爬富士山", "分了家，帶走音叉，也帶走手藝" and "二〇〇七年以後，持股一路倒過來".
The outro is t145 "…留言告訴我。" and t146 "這個頻道只講查得到的紀錄，想一起翻檔案，就訂閱。" Neither mentions a next video or file.

Within 60 s: a stake with a number (t002 "十二萬五千多台是山葉"), a moment stopped before its result (t003-t007, the race with no result yet), a promise naming the scale (t010 "一百三十多年的帳") and a question (t011 "到底是不是同一家公司？"). The only extra teasers are t008 and t009, so it stays at the limit and does not read like a list of clues.

The thread is the relationship between the piano Yamaha and the bike Yamaha, posed at t011. Each chapter moves it forward: the piano company and its tuning fork are founded (t028-t029); piano woodworking leads to propellers (t038); the propeller machines survive (t054-t056); those machines lead to the bike (t066); the bike arm is spun off (t088); the logo and craft are shared (t102, t112); the shareholdings reverse (t124-t137); the answer comes at t144.

Side details are short and tied to the question. The Toyota steering wheel (t110-t112) shows the craft that was carried over. The Taiwan piano lessons (t116-t118) show that 功學社 links both Yamahas. The design exhibition (t129-t130) shows the two cooperating. No long passage is off topic and no list of products, scores or quotes is read out. (The weakest spot is t116-t118, a three-line aside about learning piano.)
